callScript: Hi Nishi Kumari / Nishi Enterprise team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp inquiry, and a showcase of your offerings in Gola Rd, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
